english.title: Driver of vehicle fail to stop after aircraft accident at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), involved in an accident with an Aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), at Bristol Airport **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, the registration number or identification marks of the vehicle, details of the accident and details of third party insurance cover, to a Constable or Airport Official or any other person having reasonable grounds for requiring them, as soon as reasonably practicable but in any event, no later than 2 hours after the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 8.3 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
